name: SDF Grid Resampling from File
definition: Reads a raw SDF text file, parses its grid resolution, bounding box, and voxel size, then resamples it to a target cubic grid resolution using coordinate mapping and clamping.
summary: SDF Grid Resampling from File reads raw SDF data and resamples it to a target cubic grid, uniquely handling non-cubic source grids by normalizing spatial extent to a centered bounding box.
